newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINLAND PREPARES FORESTRY, FOREST INDUSTRY REPORT.
newsitem.headline: FINLAND PREPARES FORESTRY, FOREST INDUSTRY REPORT.

text.p: The government's economic policy committee has initiated work on a report on Finnish forestry and the forest industry, the ministry of agriculture and forestry (MMM) said in a statement on Tuesday.

The government's intention is to give early next year a policy report on forestry to parliament. The report, and parliament's response to it, will form the basis for a broad national forestry policy programme, MMM said.
"Global and European supply and demand prospects for the forest industry and for wood as a raw material will be taken into account," it said.
